files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Configurable notification sounds for instant messages: disabled, chime, double chime, and bell.
- A responsive settings section menu for General, Stylesheet, Instant messages, Presets and Displays.
- Save actions at the end of each global settings section.

### Changed

- The settings interface now follows the native Nextcloud layout more closely, with a persistent section menu on desktop and a two-row menu on mobile.
- The notification sound is disabled by default and is reset to disabled with the message styling defaults.
